0022600090.text: The Pelicans host the Indiana Pacers in New Orleans for their first game of the 2026-27 season, and neither team has played a game yet this season. The two teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the most recent meeting was a 127-119 Pelicans loss in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026. As of today, the Pacers are without Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), all listed as out, while New Orleans has no players listed as unavailable.
